Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Today we are going to learn four shapes.
A circle, a square, a triangle and a rectangle.
Here is a circle.
Watch my dot run all the way around it.
It never turns a corner. A circle has no corners at all.
Here is a square.
A square has four sides. Let us mark them.
One side.
Two sides.
Three sides.
Four sides.
Four sides, and every one is the same length.
Here is a triangle.
A triangle has three corners. Let us mark them.
One corner.
Two corners.
Three corners.
Three corners and three sides. That is a triangle.
Here is a rectangle.
A rectangle has four sides too, just like a square.
But look. These two sides are long.
And these two sides are short.
A square and a rectangle both have four sides.
On the square, all four sides are the same.
On the rectangle, two are long and two are short.
That is how you tell them apart.
Let us name them all one more time.
Circle.
Square.
Triangle.
Rectangle.
Four shapes, and you know every one of them now!
Now it is your turn. Drag each shape into the hole that fits it!
